The '''2nd Group''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that served in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The unit fielded [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class starfighters]] in battle.
